allowances.basis: Unquoted allowance; cannot establish full venue-required charges or a 30-minute cleanup team.

allowances.label: Unpriced fees / tax / contingency reserve
allowances.basis: Cash allowance, not calculated tax or proof all charges are covered. Check every taxable/service base; do not tax the photo package twice.

sources.note: Servers $55/hour; bartenders $60; add $5/hour outside Santa Clara County. Four-hour minimum; overtime after eight hours. Provider suggests 1 server/25 guests. Our lean 1/35 assumption needs approval.

sources.name: DJ Alphire wedding prices
sources.note: Five hours $1,650; advance extra hour $185; 201–300-person sound add-on $450. Eight-hour 300-person example $2,655. No published 330-person capacity add-on; no summer/Saturday discount assumed.

sources.name: Lynds photo + video

limits: No complete under-$30k venue match is verified.
No guest lodging reimbursement offsets are assumed.
Atmosphere, vibe and uniqueness are personal judgments for Mahdi and Rinad; no automated fit grade is required.
Quoted food applies only if the actual caterer is permitted.
Guest count 330 is base; 300 is a comparison; 280 sensitivity is below your stated ~300 capacity goal.
Music, bar and guest exit are separate midnight requirements. Your 00:30 cleanup target may need paid access until 01:00 or later.
10 vendor meals may not cover the eventual staffing/creative team; increase once contracts establish meal counts.
